name: Test Generator
description: Synthetic colour-bar video, two tone audio flows and an optional ancillary-data (captions + SCTE-104) flow written to an MXL domain. The easiest way to get a first flow into a domain.
notes: Open the web UI, pick the domain under /mxl-domain, name the flows and press Start. Flow UUIDs are derived from the group hint.

name: MXL Info GUI
description: Read-only dashboard wrapping the mxl-info CLI: domains, active/inactive/stale flows, per-flow head index and latency.

name: MediaMTX (WebRTC relay)
description: WHIP/WHEP relay used by MXL to WebRTC and WebRTC to MXL. Runs with host networking so ICE candidates carry the real host IP (ports 8554 RTSP, 8889 WebRTC, 8189/udp ICE).
notes: No web UI of its own. Launched automatically as a dependency of mxl2webrtc and webrtc2mxl.

name: MXL to WebRTC
description: Reads one MXL video and/or audio flow and plays it in the browser over WebRTC (MediaMTX relay or direct WHEP).
notes: The x264 encoder is installed from the Ubuntu archive on first start, so the container needs network access once.

name: File Player
description: Loops an MP4/TS clip from a host folder and publishes its video and audio as MXL flows.

hostPaths.label: Clips folder on the host (.mp4 / .ts files)

notes: The FFmpeg decoders (gstreamer1.0-libav) are installed on first start, so the container needs network access once.

name: HLS to MXL Gateway
description: Ingests a live HLS stream and republishes it as one MXL video flow and one MXL audio flow.

name: Input Selector
description: Frame-accurate N-to-1 MXL video switcher (native Rust backend). Routes one of up to N input flows to a single output flow.

params.label: Number of input slots
params.help: Selectable input slots in the UI and router.

name: HTML5 Keyer
description: Composites an HTML5 graphics page (embedded Chromium) over a live MXL video flow, or runs an OGraf teleprompter, and publishes the result as an MXL flow.

params.label: UI mode on load (key or prompt)

notes: Needs a 1 GB /dev/shm for Chromium. To reach a graphics server on the host use http://host.docker.internal:<port>/ inside the keyer UI.

name: WebRTC to MXL
description: Publishes a browser camera/microphone (WebRTC via MediaMTX) into an MXL domain as video and audio flows.

name: Test Writer (mxl-gst-testsrc)
description: Headless GStreamer test source from the hands-on exercises 1-3: writes a 1080p29.97 v210 video flow and a stereo audio flow into the domain mounted at /domain. No web UI.

params.label: Group hint
params.help: Group name used in the flows' grouphint tag. Use a different value per writer instance.

notes: Flow IDs are fixed by the JSON baked into the image (video 5fbec3b1-…, audio b3bb5be7-…), so run at most one instance per domain. The domain directory must be writable by uid 1000.

name: Reader / mxl-info shell
description: Read-only container with the mxl-info CLI. By default it runs `watch mxl-info -d /domain -l`; open a terminal on it to run `/app/mxl-info -d /domain -f <flow-id>`.
notes: Useful for checking what the official SDK reports (mxl-info) next to what EASY MXL shows.

name: Clip Player (looping filesrc)
description: Loops one MPEG-TS clip from the host into an MXL video flow using mxl-gst-looping-filesrc. Headless, no web UI.

hostPaths.label: MPEG-TS clip file on the host

notes: Runs as root because the entrypoint installs gstreamer1.0-libav on first start (needs network access once).
